author: valtonera
quote: Glitched out piece of trash. 20+ years and $79.99 for this crap??? GTA V on PC looks way better. And why the heck did the pay to print out game cases that have disc slots inside them, but no disk? Just put it on a paper card and call it a day. You’re not fooling anyone. Also, now that I hate it, I can’t resell it. I’m stuck with this junk. Next time I’m waiting for any digital only game to drop down to below $10 before I buy it, because this is all this game is worth until the patch it 50 billion times and finally make it playable.
